stories.headline: Pepperell zoning board hears Woodland Ridge 40B request
stories.dek: The Zoning Board of Appeals meets Wednesday, Nov 18. The agenda lists a comprehensive permit for 40B housing by Woodland Ridge.
stories.quote: Woodland Ridge 40B Comprehensive Permit/OpenGov Record No. COMP-25-2:

brief.what: Same item, flagged twice. Woodland Ridge, LLC (through attorney Melissa Robbins of Farrell, & Robbins, P.C.) wants a 40B comprehensive permit for 40 single-family homes for sale on 45.5 acres between Bancroft Street and Orion Road: 32 two-bedroom and 8 three-bedroom homes, with 10 of them (25%) affordable to households at or below 80% of area median income.
brief.where: 24 Bancroft Street, Pepperell, MA, between Bancroft Street and Orion Road
brief.size: forty (40) single-family homes on 45.5 acres; ten (10) of the homes (25%) affordable
brief.history: Also a continuation hearing on the Sep 16 Zoning Board of Appeals agenda.
brief.how_to_speak: Speak for or against in writing before the hearing, or in person at the hearing (yourself or through an agent or attorney). In person only.
brief.line: 40 homes, 10 affordable, at 24 Bancroft Street (Woodland Ridge 40B): hearing continues.
brief.quote: Parties wishing to speak in favor of, or in opposition, to the proposal may do so in writing prior to the hearing or at the hearing in person and/or represented by an agent or attorney. Interested parties are encouraged to attend.
brief.when_place: In-Person Only at the Albert Harris Center, 37 Nashua Road, Pepperell MA
brief.missing: When the hearing opened, what waivers are requested, and the nearest homes: not stated; the application is at the Planning Office, Town Hall, 1 Main Street, or on OpenGov (Record No. COMP-25-2).

stories.subject: 40 homes, 10 affordable, at 24 Bancroft Street (Woodland Ridge 40B)
stories.say: The Zoning Board of Appeals’ hearing continues. Anyone can go and speak.
